capabilities: Re-scroll to the target heading after Outline, Search, wikilink, and block-reference jumps
Unfold the target heading and its folded ancestors after a jump
Fix heading and block jumps in Outgoing links and Backlinks panes
Correct scroll in Reading view and split editor-plus-Reading layouts
Retry scrolls with configurable delay, backoff, and scroll-to-center, plus a reliable jump command
disambiguation: Does not add navigation features or a table of contents; it only corrects the scroll position of jumps that already exist in Obsidian.
extras: README is bilingual (English and Japanese), lists explicit non-goals, includes a no-warranty disclaimer, and links a Buy Me a Coffee support page.
intentEvidence: auto-corrects scroll position after heading jumps from the Outline, Search, wikilinks, block references, or link panes
problem: In Obsidian, jumping to a heading from the Outline, Search, or a [[note#heading]] link often moves the cursor without scrolling the view to that heading, especially in long notes, split layouts, or Reading view.
summary: Fix that re-scrolls to the target heading after jumps from Outline, Search, wikilinks, block references, and link panes in Live Preview and Reading view.
